title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling samples, and docs quickstarts
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Add RAG/agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples for redwood-examples; developer docs updated with step-by-step guides and sample configs.
description: Context: This PR adds a set of opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, several tool-calling example workflows, and companion quickstarts for the docs site. Motivation: make it easier for engineers to onboard RAG+agent patterns with Redwood (examples + copy-paste configs), demonstrate tool-calling patterns (search, retrieval, and external actions), and provide vetted prompts + eval scaffolding used by the docs team. Changes are split across example projects and docs markdown. Checklist: - Add RAG agent templates (python/ts) - Add tool-calling examples (search, calendar, db-query) - Integrate quickstarts into docs nav and include runnable code blocks - Add minimal CI smoke tests for examples - Update README and contributing notes - Add a short eval prompt set and tests Summary of risk: low; no runtime/runtime-only libraries changed; examples and docs only. Backwards compatibility: no breaking changes to APIs. Testing: examples validated locally against a CI-provisioned dev key and smoke tests, docs rendered locally to catch markdown issues. See commits and files_changed for details.
